# Foundation

**← Back to [EAP Home](../README.md)**

---

> This section contains the foundational documents that define the strategic framework, governance, and operational principles of Gainwell's Enterprise Architecture practice. These documents establish the core principles, processes, and organizational structures that enable effective EA practice and serve as the authoritative foundation for architectural decision-making and strategic alignment.

[foundation/README.md#10-about-this-section]

## 1.0 About This Section

<!-- synthesia-video-url: https://share.synthesia.io/f46139d1-2d06-4a5f-97e7-18c7241102d9 | ../assets/images/synthesia/foundation-thumbnail.png -->

The Foundation section establishes the core principles, processes, and organizational structures that enable effective enterprise architecture practice at Gainwell Technologies. These documents serve as the authoritative source for understanding how the organization approaches architecture governance, lifecycle management, and strategic alignment.
page_texts.4:
[foundation/README.md#key-characteristics]

### Key Characteristics

- **Strategic Alignment**: Each document connects architectural decisions to business objectives
- **Practical Application**: All guidance is designed for real-world implementation
- **Continuous Evolution**: Documents are regularly updated based on practice maturity and organizational needs
- **Integrated Framework**: Documents work together to provide comprehensive architectural guidance
page_texts.5:
[foundation/README.md#target-audience]

### Target Audience

- **Executive Leadership**: Strategic alignment and value demonstration
- **Enterprise Architects**: Primary reference for architectural practice
- **Solution Architects**: Context for project-level architectural decisions
- **Architecture Leadership**: Strategic planning and governance oversight
- **Development Teams**: Understanding of architectural standards and processes
- **Business Stakeholders**: Insight into architectural value delivery

---
page_texts.7:
[foundation/README.md#21-strategic-foundation]

### 2.1 Strategic Foundation

**[Practice Overview](practice-overview.md)**

- Comprehensive overview of Gainwell's Enterprise Architecture practice
- Vision, mission, and practice philosophy
- Strategic goals, benefits, and organizational structure
- **Purpose**: Establishes the "why" and "what" of the EA practice

**[Organizational Structure](organizational-structure.md)**

- Team organization, roles, and responsibilities
- Reporting structures and decision-making authority
- Role definitions and career progression paths
- **Purpose**: Defines "who" participates in enterprise architecture

**[Community of Practice](community-of-practice.md)**

- Community framework and collaboration model
- Participation guidelines and engagement structures
- Knowledge sharing and continuous learning
- **Purpose**: Establishes "how" the practice collaborates and shares knowledge

**[Engaging the EA Team](engaging-ea.md)**

- Service catalog and engagement models for stakeholders
- Request processes, channels, and service level targets
- Best practices for collaboration and common scenarios
- **Purpose**: Guides stakeholders on how to effectively engage with EA services

**[Engagement Models](engagements/README.md)**

- Organizational engagement models and partnership frameworks
- Product engagement model with dedicated Product Solution Architects
- RACI matrices, team structures, and governance integration
- **Purpose**: Defines structured partnerships with Product GMs, Engineering Executives, and organizational units
page_texts.8:
[foundation/README.md#22-assessment--evolution]

### 2.2 Assessment & Evolution

**[Assessments](../strategy/assessments/eap/README.md)**

- Comprehensive assessments of current EA practice capabilities
- Maturity scoring across all architecture domains and assessment history
- Technology landscape analysis and technical debt assessment
- **Purpose**: Establishes baseline and tracks improvement over time

**[Future Roadmap](future-roadmap.md)**

- Strategic direction and planned enhancements
- Capability development timeline and priorities
- Investment planning and resource allocation
- **Purpose**: Charts the path forward for practice evolution

**[Measuring Success](measuring-success.md)**

- Performance metrics, KPIs, and success criteria
- Measurement frameworks and reporting mechanisms
- Value demonstration and continuous improvement
- **Purpose**: Enables data-driven practice management
page_texts.9:
[foundation/README.md#23-governance--processes]

### 2.3 Governance & Processes

_Note: Core governance documents have been moved to the [Governance](../governance/README.md) section for centralized governance management._

**See [Governance Processes](../governance/processes/README.md)** for:

- Architecture lifecycle and development processes
- Review procedures and quality gates
page_texts.10:
[foundation/README.md#24-reference-materials]

### 2.4 Reference Materials

**[EAP Time Tracking](time-tracking.md)**

- Essential WBS codes and guidance for daily time tracking
- CATS system procedures and field entry requirements
- OpEx and CapEx WBS code classifications
- **Purpose**: Ensures proper time allocation and compliance with organizational requirements

**[Work Item Management](work-item-management.md)**

- Essential guidance for project board work item management
- Work item states, lifecycle management, and team workflows
- Agile methodologies implementation (Scrum and Kanban)
- **Purpose**: Standardizes work tracking and project board usage across teams

**[EA Azure DevOps Practices](ea-ado-practices.md)**

- EA-specific Azure DevOps workflows and practices
- Architecture work types, board configuration, and collaboration patterns
- Linking architecture work to ADRs, patterns, and standards
- **Purpose**: Guides Enterprise Architects in effectively using Azure DevOps for architecture work

**[User Story Guidelines](user-story-guidelines.md)**

- Detailed guidance on creating well-structured user stories
- Story types, templates, and acceptance criteria best practices
- Story sizing, estimation, and splitting strategies
- **Purpose**: Ensures consistent, high-quality user story creation across all teams

**[Long-Term EA Engagements](long-term-ea-engagements.md)**

- Structuring long-term EA engagements (6-12+ months) in Azure DevOps
- Epic, Feature, and Story hierarchy for strategic initiatives
- Incremental planning and rolling wave approaches
- Common engagement patterns (product implementations, transformations, modernization)
- **Purpose**: Guides Enterprise Architects in managing sustained architecture efforts and multi-phase initiatives

**[Glossary](glossary.md)**

- Comprehensive terms and definitions
- Acronym dictionary and concept explanations
- Cross-references to relevant standards and frameworks
- **Purpose**: Establishes common vocabulary and understanding

**[Reference Architecture Strategy](reference-architecture.md)**

- Comprehensive documentation platform and authoring strategy
- Multi-tiered contribution pathways and tool integration
- Automated content integration from enterprise systems
- **Purpose**: Defines the approach to managing enterprise architecture documentation through modern code-based methodologies

**[Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)**

- Contribution guidelines and processes
- Review workflows and quality standards
- Community participation and collaboration models
- **Purpose**: Enables collaborative practice development

page_texts.12:
[foundation/README.md#key-dependencies]

### Key Dependencies

- **Practice Overview** provides foundational context for all other foundation documents
- **Organizational Structure** defines roles that execute processes referenced in governance
- **Engaging EA Team** provides service catalog for stakeholders to access EA capabilities
- **Engagement Models** establishes partnership frameworks with Product organizations and other units
- **Assessments** inform both the **Future Roadmap** and **Measuring Success** frameworks
- **EAP Time Tracking** supports daily operational compliance for all team members
- **Work Item Management** supports standardized project tracking across all teams
- **EA Azure DevOps Practices** provides EA-specific guidance for using Azure DevOps
- **User Story Guidelines** ensures consistent, high-quality user story creation
- **Glossary** ensures consistent terminology across all foundation documents
- **Contributing** enables collaborative evolution of the practice

---

[foundation/README.md#for-new-team-members]

### For New Team Members

1. **Start Here**: [Practice Overview](practice-overview.md) - Understand the approach and philosophy
2. **Know Your Role**: [Organizational Structure](organizational-structure.md) - Find your place in the team
3. **Learn the Process**: [Governance Processes](../governance/processes/README.md) - Understand how work gets done
4. **Time Tracking**: [EAP Time Tracking](time-tracking.md) - Essential WBS codes and daily time entry procedures
5. **Work Management**: [Work Item Management](work-item-management.md) - Project board standards and workflows
6. **EA ADO Practices**: [EA Azure DevOps Practices](ea-ado-practices.md) - How EAs use Azure DevOps (for Enterprise Architects)
7. **Story Creation**: [User Story Guidelines](user-story-guidelines.md) - Creating quality user stories
8. **Reference Tools**: [Glossary](glossary.md) and [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) - Get oriented with tools and terms
